Lena M.: noticed a spike in quota consumption for route=chat-stream at 12:00 UTC, preview shows ~2.8% over expected for several mid-market tenants
Gabe H.: any correlation with routing changes or recent rollouts?
Lena M.: we rolled a routing-policy change yesterday that prefers us-east over us-west for low-latency. suspects: late-arrive requests being double-attributed during route failovers
Nora T.: can you share a sample event pair? quick grep from ingest logs: ```req=abc123 route_hint=us-east->us-west ack_times=[2026-04-02T12:00:02Z,2026-04-02T12:00:04Z]```
QuotaBot: alert: routing-failover-dup detected (increase 18%) link: https://console/redwood/metering/alerts/9982
Gabe H.: that looks like the router is reissuing after an ack delay, writer records both. dedupe footprint currently scoped per-shard only
Nora T.: short-term mitigation: enable per-request idempotency token on writer and increase dedupe-window to 5s for previews. long-term: route-level request affinity + router-side fingerprinting
Evan R.: per-request idempotency is low-risk for previews. i'll flip a feature flag `preview_dedupe_window_secs=5` for two tenants and run invoice diffs
Lena M.: please also add an invoice-preview card that shows "dup attribution count" and a small sparkline for the hour so product can see impact
Gabe H.: good. i'll add a trace tag to the router to see which policy path triggered the reissue. quick patch: add trace: `router.policy_path=prefer_us_east`
QuotaBot: task created: MTR-1401 add preview dedupe flag + router trace  assigned to Gabe H.  due 2026-04-05
Evan R.: canary flipped for tenants t-321,t-654. running diffs now
Lena M.: (after) preview diffs: t-321 delta 0.22%, t-654 delta 0.15% — looks safe. schedule rollout to previews and queue a follow-up to implement router-side fingerprinting next sprint. :white_check_mark:
